summary: One-frame request to make a character inherit the faction of another entity (summon owner). Added inline by bg3.exe+0x3324CB0 (storage set up by bg3.exe+0x3336DC0, AllocRaw 8) once with the null handle and once with an entity handle from a list, next to esv::Character summon-owner calls (FUN_1435f79b0 / FUN_1435f7860). Consumed by esv::relation::RelationSystem::ProcessSetInheritedRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x88AAE0), which writes the requested handle into eoc::relation::FactionComponent+0x28 (SE: SummonOwner). Never seen alive. Registry total 8 (server row).

fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3324CB0: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 8) then `*puVar9 = DAT_146174970` (the null EntityHandle global) in one branch and `*puVar9 = *(undefined8 *)(lVar14 + lVar12 * 8)` (an entity of a handle list) in the other. Toolkit RelationSystem::ProcessSetInheritedRequests stores the gathered 8-byte value to FactionComponent+0x28, which SE names SummonOwner (EntityHandle).
